name: GitHub CLI (gh)
description: GitHub CLI (https://cli.github.com) as a member of this collection's ecosystem: keeps a gh already in the image (e.g. from the official ghcr.io/devcontainers/features/github-cli, which is augmented instead of replaced) or installs the sha256-verified release binary at /usr/local/bin/gh (version pinnable); owns the login state as a named volume at GH_CONFIG_DIR=/var/lib/devcontainer-features/gh so `gh auth login` survives rebuilds; and adds a post-create hook (gh-setup) that makes that directory usable by the remote user, configures git to take GitHub credentials from gh, and reports whether a login is present. Plus the Feature Taskfile.

installTaskfile.description: Also install this Feature's Taskfile into /usr/local/share/go-task/includes.d so its tasks appear under the <id>: namespace of a root Taskfile that includes /usr/local/share/go-task/features.yml (see the go-task Feature).

install.description: How the gh binary gets there. 'auto': keep a gh already in the image (official Feature, base image) and only add the ecosystem pieces, else install the verified release binary. 'native': always install the verified release binary at /usr/local/bin/gh. 'none': never install the binary, only the pieces.

version.description: GitHub CLI release to install (e.g. '2.80.0', with or without a leading 'v'), or 'latest'. Ignored when an existing gh is kept (install=auto) or install=none.

gitCredentialHelper.description: At post-create, configure git (global config) to take credentials for https://github.com from gh (`!gh auth git-credential`), so git push/pull use the gh login. Override per container with GH_SETUP_GIT_CREDENTIAL_HELPER in containerEnv.
